DOWNLOADER.description: Your nickname on the ArchiveTeam leaderboards (tracker.archiveteam.org). No spaces or emails.

SELECTED_PROJECT.description: auto lets ArchiveTeam point your Warrior at the most urgent project. Or name one, e.g. reddit or telegram.

CONCURRENT_ITEMS.description: Items worked on at once (1-6). More uses more RAM and bandwidth.

HTTP_USERNAME.description: Username for the Warrior web dashboard

HTTP_PASSWORD.description: Password for the Warrior web dashboard - without it anyone with the URL could change your settings

PORT.description: Port of the Warrior dashboard - leave as is
